scripts.build: pnpm --filter @text-trace/core build && pnpm --filter @text-trace/vue build && pnpm --filter @text-trace/react build && pnpm --filter text-trace-playground build
scripts.release: pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' publish --publish-branch main
scripts.release:dry-run: pnpm check && pnpm build && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' publish --publish-branch main --dry-run --no-git-checks
